meaning.en: To be flustered and helpless for lack of preparation.
meaning.zh: 因事先没有准备而手足无措、干着急。

examples.zh: 考试前不复习，到时候就抓瞎了。
examples.en: If you don't revise before the exam, you'll be lost.

examples.zh: 新系统一出问题，大家都抓瞎。
examples.en: When the new system broke, everyone was at a loss.

usage.en: Often 两眼一抹黑/临时抓瞎. Northern colloquial.
usage.zh: 常与“两眼一抹黑”同用，北方口语。

meaning.en: Being the sort of person others find irritating.
meaning.zh: 惹人厌烦。

examples.zh: 他爱插嘴，真讨人嫌。
examples.en: He keeps butting in, which is really irritating.

examples.zh: 别做讨人嫌的事。
examples.en: Don't do things that annoy people.

usage.en: Casual; used of people or behaviour. Opposite 讨人喜欢.
usage.zh: 口语，反义为“讨人喜欢”。

meaning.en: A person who speaks bluntly and flares up easily.
meaning.zh: 指说话直、脾气急、爱发火的人。

examples.zh: 他是个炮筒子，一点就着。
examples.en: He's a hothead who flares up in a flash.

examples.zh: 别惹那个炮筒子。
examples.en: Don't provoke that firecracker.

usage.en: Describes a person; usually affectionate-teasing rather than hostile.
usage.zh: 指人，多半是打趣而非恶意。

meaning.en: To travel and trade alone, buying and selling goods.
meaning.zh: 指个人独自往来各地贩卖货物，或单干。

examples.zh: 他年轻时跑单帮，南来北往赚辛苦钱。
examples.en: In his youth he traded alone up and down the country.

examples.zh: 现在不少人在网上跑单帮。
examples.en: Many now trade on their own online.

usage.en: Old term for itinerant lone traders; also 'going solo'.
usage.zh: 旧指单身往来各地贩运货物的小商人，也泛指单干。

meaning.en: To dress things up for show to look more impressive.
meaning.zh: 为了好看、有面子而装点外表。

examples.zh: 他买名牌只是为了装门面。
examples.en: He buys brands just for show.

examples.zh: 这些书摆着装门面，没人看。
examples.en: The books are only for show; nobody reads them.

usage.en: Very close to 撑门面, but with a negative sense of mere show.
usage.zh: 与“撑门面”相近，更强调徒有其表。

meaning.en: To act self-important and stand on one's dignity.
meaning.zh: 故意摆出高傲姿态，显示身份。

examples.zh: 他当了经理就爱拿架子。
examples.en: Since becoming manager he likes to put on airs.

examples.zh: 请他帮忙，他还拿起架子来了。
examples.en: When I asked for help, he started acting lofty.

usage.en: 摆架子 is the most common form; 搭架子 is rarer and sometimes means 'set up a framework'.
usage.zh: “摆架子”最常用；“搭架子”较少见，有时指搭框架。

meaning.en: To maintain an outward show of prosperity or status.
meaning.zh: 勉强维持外表的体面。

examples.zh: 为了撑门面，他借钱办了场大宴席。
examples.en: To keep up appearances he borrowed money for a lavish banquet.

examples.zh: 小公司租了豪华办公室撑门面。
examples.en: The small firm rented a posh office for show.

usage.en: Slightly less critical than 装门面; also fine for genuinely holding up a business's good name.
usage.zh: 比“装门面”语气稍轻，也可指撑起场面。

natural: try to get something for nothing

meaning.en: To try to gain advantage at others' expense.
meaning.zh: 想占别人的小便宜。

examples.zh: 他总想讨便宜，从不肯吃亏。
examples.en: He's always angling for an advantage and never takes a loss.

examples.zh: 买东西别想着讨便宜。
examples.en: Don't go shopping hoping to get a bargain off someone.

usage.en: Note pián yi (advantage), not biàn yi. 讨便宜 is also used for 'be taken advantage of' only by context.
usage.zh: 注意读 pián yi。多指想占便宜。

meaning.en: To spoil one's appetite, or to disgust or bore someone.
meaning.zh: 使人没有食欲，也比喻令人厌烦。

examples.zh: 这种广告看多了真倒胃口。
examples.en: Seeing too many of these ads is a real turn-off.

examples.zh: 他说话那么粗，让人倒胃口。
examples.en: He's so crude that it puts people off.

usage.en: Literal and figurative; 倒 here is dǎo (to spoil).
usage.zh: 本义和引申义都常用，“倒”读 dǎo。

meaning.en: To work slowly and lazily on purpose.
meaning.zh: 故意拖拉、做事不卖力。

examples.zh: 别在这儿磨洋工，赶紧干活。
examples.en: Stop dawdling and get to work.

examples.zh: 他一整天都在磨洋工。
examples.en: He's been slacking off all day.

usage.en: From 洋工, the old term for work done with foreign (洋) piece-wage or machinery arrangements; its exact origin is uncertain.
usage.zh: “洋工”来历有多种说法，说法不一。

meaning.en: To take a free ride in someone's vehicle, or benefit from others' effort.
meaning.zh: 免费搭乘别人的车，也比喻不出力而享受别人的成果。

examples.zh: 我的车坏了，只好搭同事的便车。
examples.en: My car broke down, so I had to hitch a lift with a colleague.

examples.zh: 小组作业里总有人想搭便车。
examples.en: There's always someone in group work who wants a free ride.

usage.en: Both literal and figurative ('free-rider' effect).
usage.zh: 字面义和比喻义（搭便车行为）都常用。

meaning.en: To fall over; figuratively, to suffer a setback.
meaning.zh: 本指摔倒，也比喻受挫折。

examples.zh: 路滑，他摔了个大跟头。
examples.en: The road was slick and he took a big tumble.

examples.zh: 创业路上难免摔跟头。
examples.en: You're bound to stumble when starting a business.

usage.en: More literal than 栽跟头 (which is mostly figurative).
usage.zh: 比“栽跟头”更偏字面义。

meaning.en: To follow what is fashionable.
meaning.zh: 追随流行的事物。

examples.zh: 年轻人爱赶潮流。
examples.en: Young people love following trends.

examples.zh: 她一赶潮流就花很多钱。
examples.en: She spends a lot whenever she chases the latest fashion.

usage.en: Neutral to mildly teasing; also 赶时髦.
usage.zh: 中性或略带调侃，也说“赶时髦”。

meaning.en: To flatter or sweet-talk someone to make them do as you wish.
meaning.zh: 比喻用好听的话奉承人，使其糊涂。

examples.zh: 别听他灌米汤，他有求于你。
examples.en: Don't fall for his flattery; he wants something.

examples.zh: 给领导灌了不少米汤。
examples.en: He plied the boss with plenty of flattery.

usage.en: Cf. the stronger 灌迷魂汤. Image: feeding someone a sweet, soothing soup so they go along.
usage.zh: 近于“灌迷魂汤”，比喻用甜言蜜语让人糊涂。

meaning.en: To make illicit or easy gains from one's position.
meaning.zh: 比喻利用职务之便获取不正当的好处。

examples.zh: 他当采购就为了捞油水。
examples.en: He took the purchasing job to line his pockets.

examples.zh: 想从这里捞点油水可不容易。
examples.en: It won't be easy to skim anything off here.

usage.en: Image: fat floating on soup. Often 捞点油水.
usage.zh: 常说“捞点油水”，像从汤里捞出油脂。

meaning.en: For an unexpected result to occur, especially an underdog winning.
meaning.zh: 指意料之外的结果，尤指弱者获胜。

examples.zh: 本届比赛爆出大冷门，种子选手早早出局。
examples.en: A huge upset occurred, and the seeded players went out early.

examples.zh: 这次考试他爆冷门拿了第一。
examples.en: He sprang a surprise and took first place in the exam.

usage.en: Common in sports and betting; usually 爆出冷门/爆大冷门.
usage.zh: 多用于体育和博彩，常说“爆出冷门”。

meaning.en: To run a red traffic light; also to break the rules.
meaning.zh: 指不顾红灯通行，比喻违反规定。

examples.zh: 过马路闯红灯很危险。
examples.en: Crossing against the red light is dangerous.

examples.zh: 这件事已经闯了红灯，不能再做了。
examples.en: This move has crossed a red line and can't continue.

usage.en: Literal and figurative; modern.
usage.zh: 字面义和比喻义都用，是现代说法。

meaning.en: To do something only for show, without real effort.
meaning.zh: 只做表面功夫，不是真心实意。

examples.zh: 他拿本书装样子，其实在发呆。
examples.en: He held a book for show but was really daydreaming.

examples.zh: 这个检查只是装样子。
examples.en: This inspection is only for show.

usage.en: Casual; implies insincerity.
usage.zh: 口语，含不真诚的意味。

meaning.en: To reveal one's real position or last resource.
meaning.zh: 比喻公开自己的真实意图或最后的实力。

equivalents: lay one's cards on the table

examples.zh: 谈判到最后，他终于亮出了底牌。
examples.en: At the end of the talks he finally showed his hand.

examples.zh: 现在亮底牌还太早。
examples.en: It's too early to lay our cards on the table.

usage.en: Often 亮出底牌. Opposite of 藏一手.
usage.zh: 常说“亮出底牌”。

meaning.en: Rice that is half cooked; figuratively, a job or knowledge only half done.
meaning.zh: 半生不熟的饭，比喻没做好或没学透的事。

examples.zh: 基础没打好，学成了夹生饭。
examples.en: Without a solid foundation, what you learn stays half-baked.

examples.zh: 这项工程做成了夹生饭。
examples.en: The project ended up half-finished.

usage.en: Often 煮成夹生饭 (end up half done).
usage.zh: 常说“煮成夹生饭”。

meaning.en: To jeer at a poor performance, mockingly applauding it.
meaning.zh: 对演出或表现不满，故意起哄喝彩，表示嘲笑。

examples.zh: 球迷对裁判喝倒彩。
examples.en: The fans jeered at the referee.

examples.zh: 他一出丑，台下就有人喝倒彩。
examples.en: As soon as he made a fool of himself, someone in the audience jeered.

usage.en: Note hè (shout), not hē (drink). Opposite 喝彩.
usage.zh: 注意“喝”读 hè，反义为“喝彩”。

meaning.en: A humorous or rude word for dying.
meaning.zh: 对“死”的诙谐或不敬说法。

examples.zh: 那个老头早就翘辫子了。
examples.en: The old man kicked the bucket long ago.

examples.zh: 再这么熬夜，早晚得翘辫子。
examples.en: Keep staying up late and you'll croak sooner or later.

usage.en: Said to come from the Qing queue, which stiffened upward at death. Rude or jokey; avoid in respectful talk.
usage.zh: 相传与清代男子的辫子有关，含戏谑，不用于尊重场合。

meaning.en: To pat one's chest, promising something confidently.
meaning.zh: 拍着胸口，表示有把握，作保证。

examples.zh: 他拍着胸脯保证按时完成。
examples.en: He vowed with a thump on the chest to finish on time.

examples.zh: 他爱拍胸脯，可是常常做不到。
examples.en: He likes to thump his chest, but often can't deliver.

usage.en: Usually 拍着胸脯 + promise; 脯 here is pú.
usage.zh: 常说“拍着胸脯保证”，“脯”读 pú。

meaning.en: To pat someone's shoulder in encouragement or friendship.
meaning.zh: 拍对方的肩膀，表示鼓励或亲近。

examples.zh: 老板拍了拍他的肩膀，说了声“干得好”。
examples.en: The boss patted his shoulder and said 'Well done'.

examples.zh: 他习惯用拍肩膀的方式表示鼓励。
examples.en: He likes to show encouragement with a pat on the shoulder.

usage.en: Usually literal; implies approval or closeness.
usage.zh: 多为字面义，表示赞许或亲近。

meaning.en: To take away someone's job or livelihood.
meaning.zh: 比喻夺取别人的工作或生计。

examples.zh: 同行之间互相抢饭碗，对谁都没好处。
examples.en: Rivals stealing each other's livelihoods helps nobody.

examples.zh: 新来的员工抢了他的饭碗。
examples.en: The new hire took his job away.

usage.en: Rice bowl stands for one's livelihood; see 铁饭碗.
usage.zh: “饭碗”比喻职业、生计。
